$description: Spacing scale for the 'adminlte-classic' template (Classic Admin). Obtained by observing the public visual identity of AdminLTE — a scale based on 4px/8px increments over a 16px base, typical of data-dense dashboards. Original document — see ATTRIBUTION.md.

1.$description: 4px — minimum spacing, between an icon and adjacent text.

2.$description: 8px — inner padding of small elements (badges, compact buttons).

4.$description: 16px — base unit. Default card padding, gap between elements within a group.

5.$description: 24px — gap between cards in a grid, section padding.

8.$description: 48px — page margins, breathing room between header and main content.

card-padding.$description: Default inner padding of the card body.

card-header-padding-y.$description: Vertical padding of the card header.

table-cell-padding-x.$description: Horizontal padding of a table cell.

table-cell-padding-y.$description: Vertical padding of a table cell — compact, to fit more visible rows.

grid-gap.$description: Default gap between cards/panels in a dashboard grid.

sidebar-padding-x.$description: Horizontal inner padding of side navigation items.

sidebar-width.$description: 250px — default width of the side navigation on large screens.

icon-sm.$description: Icon box beside font.size.xs text: dense table cells, badges, trailing hints. See foundations/iconography.md.

icon-md.$description: Default icon box, paired with font.size.sm text — most of the interface.

icon-lg.$description: Icon box beside font.size.base or lg text: large buttons, empty states.

avatar-sm.$description: Avatar in a table row or a message thread. See foundations/imagery.md.

avatar-md.$description: Avatar in the navbar account control and in list items.

viz-height.$description: 220px — default height of a fixed-height visualisation area inside a card body: a map canvas, or any other visual whose height cannot be derived from its content. Charts that carry axes use a taller plot (see specs/trend-chart-card.md); compact sparklines use their own smaller height. Fixing this as a token keeps a row of visualisation cards aligned and stops the layout shifting while the visual loads.
